extracted.intended_audience: registrants' legal and accounting teams, securities lawyers, auditors preparing merger proxy statements and Form S-4/F-4 filings
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing merger proxy statements (Schedule 14A) and registration statements on Form S-4/F-4, focusing on financial statement, audit, reconciliation, age, and disclosure requirements for acquirers and targets (including foreign targets and FPIs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Waiver of audited financial statements for closely held investors
rubrics_metrics.description: The SEC staff may waive the requirement for audited financial statements when there are only a limited number of investors who have close association and access to information concerning the registrant’s performance (example: 16 investors closely associated with ABC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is because such investors have access to information concerning performance. Citation: FRM 1150, SAB Topic 1.F.

rubrics_metrics.name: Omission of operating bank financial statements when reorganizing under new holding entity
rubrics_metrics.description: The operating bank's financial statements may be omitted from the registration statement if the operating bank separately furnishes to its shareholders financial statements prepared under US GAAP (need not be audited) for at least the most recently completed fiscal year and specified conditions are met.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conditions include: Form S-4 is filed to register common stock of newly formed holding entity to acquire 100% of operating bank; transaction satisfies all criteria in General Instruction G of Form S-4 (reorganization with no changes in relative interests, involves no leverage, results in no new classes of stock). Statistical disclosures per Item 1400 of Reg S-K may also be omitted. However, when registrant files its first Form 10-K, audited financial statements and other required statistical disclosures must be furnished for at least the two most recent fiscal years. [FRM 1150, SAB Topic 1.F]

rubrics_metrics.name: General Instruction G compliance and automatic effectiveness of Form S-4
rubrics_metrics.description: Form S-4 registration statements automatically become effective 20 days after initial filing if registrants mark the box on the cover that they are in compliance with the form's General Instruction G; failure to check the box or meet all conditions prevents automatic effectiveness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To be compliant, the transaction must involve organization of a bank or S&L holding company and the sole purpose of registering shares on Form S-4 must be to acquire the stock of the company organizing the holding company. Noncompliance means no automatic effectiveness, though financial statements may still be not required if SAB Topic 1F conditions are met. [FRM 1150, SAB Topic 1F]

rubrics_metrics.name: US GAAP reconciliation for foreign targets using non-US GAAP
rubrics_metrics.description: If a foreign target prepares financial statements using a comprehensive body of accounting principles other than US GAAP or IFRS (IASB), the registrant must provide a reconciliation to US GAAP in accordance with Item 17 of Form 20-F.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If reconciliation is unavailable or not obtainable without unreasonable cost or expense, the filing must include at minimum a narrative description of all material variations in accounting principles, practices, and methods. Registrants should consider facts and circumstances and are encouraged to consult SEC staff (CF-OCA) before omitting a reconciliation. This exception does not apply to pro forma financial information under S-X Article 11. [Form S-4 Item 17 (Instr 2); FRM 2200.9]

rubrics_metrics.name: Permitted use of Form 20-F financial statements by FPIs in lieu of Reg S-X
rubrics_metrics.description: A foreign private issuer (FPI), other than certain exceptions, may file the financial statements required by Item 8.A of Form 20-F in lieu of the financial statements specified in Regulation S-X.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See §§210.3-01, 210.3-02, and 210.3-12 permitting Item 8.A treatment and age specified in Item 8.A of Form 20-F. See chapter 6 for additional guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit requirement for foreign non-registrant targets
rubrics_metrics.description: Financial statements of a foreign business that is not an SEC registrant must be audited under US GAAS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interpretive response: No unique additional audit exceptions; see chapter 6 for matters specific to foreign registrants. [FRM 4210.3]

rubrics_metrics.name: Form F-4 vs Form S-4 financial statement differences
rubrics_metrics.description: Form F-4 permits use of financial statements required by Item 8.A of Form 20-F and contains specific Item 14/Item 17 mappings for information about foreign registrants and companies being acquired.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Excerpts from Form F-4 list required Items (e.g., Items 4.A–C, 4.D, 8.A.7, 10.D–E, Item 3.A, Item 5/Item 11, Item 18 financial statements) and instructions that financial statements shall comply with Item 8.A of Form 20-F. [FRM 2200.1]

rubrics_metrics.name: Merger proxy statement use and required compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: A merger proxy statement filed on Schedule 14A is used to solicit approval of a business combination by acquiring and/or target shareholders; if consideration includes registered securities, registrant must also comply with Form S-4/F-4 financial statement requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Voting requirements often based on majority of outstanding shares; which parties must vote depends on state law, bylaws, or articles of incorporation—consult legal counsel if unsure. FPIs do not file Schedule 14A but may still require shareholder vote due to local laws. [§240.3a12-3]

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 14A preliminary/definitive proxy and annual report furnishing requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: No solicitation subject to Regulation 14A shall be made unless each person solicited is furnished a publicly-filed preliminary or definitive proxy statement (or registration statement on Form S-4/F-4/N-14) containing specified information; if used for annual meetings with director elections, each proxy statement must be accompanied or preceded by an annual report containing specified financials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annual report requirement: consolidated audited balance sheets as of end of two most recent fiscal years and audited statements of income and cash flows for each of the three most recent fiscal years prepared per Regulation S-X, with certain Article 3/11 exceptions; smaller reporting companies may provide Article 8 information in lieu. See §240.14a-3(b)(1) and related rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: When Schedule 14A requires full Reg S-X financials for business combination items
rubrics_metrics.description: If proxy solicitation materials are used for a meeting soliciting votes with respect to Item 11, Item 12 (involving Item 14), or Item 14 (Mergers, Consolidations, Acquisitions), then Schedule 14A generally requires financial statements that fully comply with Regulation S-X in proxy materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The merger proxy statement must include information about the transaction, acquiring entity, and/or target and pro forma financial information similar to Form S-4 requirements. [§240-14a-101 (Note A)]

rubrics_metrics.name: Mapping of financial statement requirements by type of consideration and items
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine financial statement requirements based on whether proxy solicitation involves Item 11/12/14 and whether consideration includes registered securities, exempt securities, or cash.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table summarized: Item 11 or 12 unrelated to acquisition -> requirements per Item 13; Item 11/12 involving registered securities -> per Form S-4; Item 11/12 involving exempt securities -> determined per Item 13 and Item 14; cash only (only Item 14) -> per Item 14. Note that Item 13 may include S-X Rule 3-05 and Article 11 requirements for other transactions. See section 5.4.20.

rubrics_metrics.name: Age/update considerations for target financial statements in merger proxies
rubrics_metrics.description: There are no unique age considerations for merger proxy statements; the requirement to update target entity financial statements is based on the registrant's obligation under S-X Rule 3-12 (or Rule 8-08 for an SRC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See section 4.4 for update guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule 14A exceptions requiring special attention (going-private, roll-up, registered investment companies)
rubrics_metrics.description: Schedule 14A provides exceptions and special attention for going-private transactions, roll-up transactions, and transactions involving registered investment companies and business development companies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Going-private transactions: governed by Rule 13e-3 with specific disclosure requirements. Roll-up transactions: see Reg S-K Item 914 (Pro forma financial statements: selected financial data). For registered investment companies and BDCs, provide information outlined in Schedule 14A Item 14(d).

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 11 content requirements (authorization/issuance of securities other than for exchange)
rubrics_metrics.description: If action relates to authorization or issuance of securities otherwise than for exchange, state the title and amount of securities; furnish information required by Item 202 of Reg S-K; describe transaction including nature and approximate amount of consideration and approximate uses of net proceeds; if terms cannot be stated, state that board will determine terms; furnish Item 13(a) information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If statutory provisions re: preemptive rights are complex, an opinion of counsel as to existence/extent suffices. If securities are additional shares of a class outstanding, description may be omitted except for preemptive rights statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 12 content requirements (modification or exchange of securities)
rubrics_metrics.description: If action involves modification of a class of securities or issuance/exchange of securities, state title and amount, basis of exchange, describe material differences between outstanding and modified/new securities, state reasons and effect on holders, furnish details of arrears/defaults, outline other material features, and furnish Item 13(a) information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If plan is set out in a written document, file copies with the Commission per §240.14a-6. If existing security is listed, state whether registrant intends to apply for listing of new security and the effect of termination of listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 13 requirement to furnish financial statements meeting Regulation S-X
rubrics_metrics.description: If action is taken with respect to any matter specified in Item 11 or 12, furnish financial statements meeting the requirements of Regulation S-X.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Notes D and E at beginning of Schedule 14A for related instructions and exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Significance threshold (20%) for target financial information
rubrics_metrics.description: If the company being acquired is significant to the registrant in excess of the 20% level (as determined under §210.3-05(b)(2)), provide financial statements of the company being acquired for the latest fiscal year in conformity with GAAP; if significant at or below 20%, no financial information for the company being acquired need be provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In determining significance, apply the tests in Rule 1-02(w) (§210.1-02(w) of this chapter).

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit practicability and previous audits for required fiscal years
rubrics_metrics.description: The financial statements required for the latest fiscal year need be audited only to the extent practicable; financial statements for fiscal years before the latest need not be audited if they were not previously audited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If form is used to register resales to the public by an underwriter within meaning of Rule 145(c), the financial statements must be audited for the fiscal years required to be presented under paragraph (b)(2) of Rule 3-05 of Regulation S-X (17 CFR 210.3-05(b)(2)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-US GAAP financial statements instructions (reconciliation or narrative)
rubrics_metrics.description: If financial statements required are prepared on the basis of a comprehensive body of accounting principles other than U.S. GAAP, provide a reconciliation to U.S. GAAP in accordance with Item 17 of Form 20-F unless reconciliation is unavailable or not obtainable without unreasonable cost or expense; at minimum provide narrative description of material variations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This instruction applies to financial statements prepared on a basis other than U.S. GAAP for purposes of paragraphs (b)(5) and (b)(6). See related instructions earlier regarding registrant obligations and consultation with SEC staff when omitting reconciliations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application of Regulation S-X and pro forma/statistical disclosure requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Registration statements on Forms S-4 and F-4 require financial information complying with Reg S-X, including audited annual and unaudited interim historical financial statements and pro forma financial information giving effect to significant acquired or to be acquired businesses; statistical disclosures (e.g., Item 1400 of Reg S-K) may be omitted in some reorganizations but later required in first Form 10-K.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Background: information requirements of Forms S-4 and F-4 set out in three parts: (1) information about the transaction, (2) information about the registrant, and (3) information about the business being acquired. Pro forma financial information prepared under S-X Article 11 is not excepted from US GAAP reconciliation exceptions.
